name: Solving Problems
overview: Scripture teaches that solving problems begins with trusting the LORD wholeheartedly and not relying on our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5-6 instructs believers to acknowledge God in all their ways so He will direct their paths. This divine guidance is essential even in difficult relationships, where Jesus commands us to love our enemies and do good to those who hate us, demonstrating the transformative power of Christ-centered love (Luke 6:27). The rejection of Christ by His own people, as noted in John 1:11, reminds us that problems often arise from spiritual opposition, yet God’s plan remains sovereign and purposeful. The questioning of John the Baptist’s identity in John 1:19 and 1:25 further underscores the importance of recognizing God’s appointed means for salvation and guidance in times of uncertainty.
